issuer: the National Transport and Safety Authority (NTSA)
note: Read 2026-10-31 on NTSA's own agency page on the government's eCitizen portal (ntsa.ecitizen.go.ke, 'Driving License'; ntsa.go.ke gave no answer to this egress, and its archived service page is an empty script shell): no driving licence or provisional licence is granted to anyone under 18 except for motorcycles; a licence on renewal is valid for twelve months or three years at the holder's option. The term and fee are null: the holder's two terms can't be written without each term's fee, and the smart licence's fee (KES 3,050 on NTSA's own service page, seen only in a search snippet) wasn't read on a page this egress reached.

sources.title: Driving License, National Transport and Safety Authority (NTSA) on eCitizen
sources.said: A driving license is issued as an authority to allow a person to drive a motor vehicle of any class on a road. ... The renewal period will either be valid for a period of twelve (12) months or three (3) years from the date of issue at the option of the holder. ... Under the age of eighteen (18) years, except in respect of motor cycles
